title: Ray Bradbury's "There Will Come Soft Rains" is set today (2026-08-04)
summary: This is a Hacker News post highlighting that Ray Bradbury's 1950 short story 'There Will Come Soft Rains' is set on August 4, 2026, the current date. The story depicts a fully automated smart home continuing its routines after humanity's extinction. The post sparks discussion about the story's prescient vision of AI-driven home automation and its eerie relevance today.
